text:
Olivia: Quick sync request 1: Partner NexusCloud wants to run a third-party audit of our marketplace metering pipeline. Theyre asking for the reconciliation manifest format and a mapping between their rollup fields and our ledger. Can we confirm what we can share?

Marcus: We can share aggregated reconciliation manifests (signed) and per-hour deltas, but not raw device ids. Need to hash device ids and redact PII. Also ensure shared manifests include provenance metadata: partner_id, manifest_ts, signature, and comparator_version.

Helena: Agreed. Proposed manifest fields to share: [{"hour_utc": "2026-03-20T14:00:00Z", "partner_rollup_units": "123.5", "redacted_ledger_units": "123.2", "delta": "0.3", "delta_pct": "0.24%"}]. Signature should be our HMAC-SHA256 over canonicalized JSON and we include public-key fingerprint.

Ravi: From compliance: also include reconciliation_run_id, ledger_snapshot_hash, and list of reconciliation_rules_version used. We must record what inputs were compared (hour ranges, skus) for audit traceability.

audit-bot: Policy check: sharing aggregated deltas is allowed if device identifiers are irreversibly hashed and no raw IPs/timestamps are included beyond hour buckets. Pass.

Olivia: NexusCloud also asked for a signed CSV of all unmatched partner_rollup rows with reason codes (e.g., MISSING_LEDGER_ROW, AMBIGUOUS_MATCH). Are we comfortable providing that?

Marcus: MISSING_LEDGER_ROW is okay if we only include hashed_device_prefix (first 8 hex of sha256) + hour_utc + partner_units + reason. Don't include full hash-to-device mapping. AMBIGUOUS_MATCH should be rare; for those route to investigation rather than share.

Helena: Operationally, we'll produce two artifacts per daily run: 1) reconciliation_manifest.json (aggregates + metadata + signature), 2) exceptions_delta.csv (hashed_prefix, hour_utc, partner_units, reason). We'll store both in a signed S3 bucket and share temporary presigned URLs (7-day TTL).

Ravi: Legal note: we need a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) clause for audits and a separate NDA for access to exception details. Recommend limiting exception CSVs to partners with explicit permission.

FinanceBot: Automation: when exceptions > threshold (abs(delta) > 0.5% OR > 10 units for the day) create ticket FIN-RECON-<date> and attach manifest.

Marcus: Implementation notes: canonicalization: sort keys lexicographically, strip whitespace, numbers as decimals with 3-digit precision. HMAC secret rotates monthly; include secret_id in metadata. Use reconciliation service v2 comparator.

Olivia: NexusCloud -> also asked for replay provenance: if they submit a replay batch_id, we should map that to ledger write events. We can include source_batch_id counts but not full payload. OK?

Helena: Yes; include source_batch_counts: {accepted: 120, duplicates: 3, replays_over_grace_window: 2}. That gives transparency without exposing raw records.

Ravi: Action items: Helena (manifest schema + S3 artifact pipeline, ETA 4d), Marcus (hash-prefix policy + signing lib + secret rotation, ETA 3d), Olivia (update partner onboarding docs + legal checklist, ETA 2d), Finance (threshold ticket automation, ETA 5d). NexusCloud legal team must sign DPA/NDA before we enable exception CSVs.

Olivia: Sounds good. I'll draft the short partner note and send the DPA template. Meeting end.
